title: Looks cute for the year..
text: Looks cute for the year... I dont know what I was expecting but this is made of plastic. ... Altho its not too thin and flimsy its still plastic..so that means the markers that come with it for personalizing will not work. I used a sharpie ultra fine point pen for the names and waited for it to dry a few seconds. It did not smear and dried well. So you can used the ones it comes with for other stuff.lol. Comes with a red ribbon to tie and hang up on the tree with. Cute ornament but wish it was just a bit heavier plastic for the weight while it hangs...maybe glue something on the back...
